title: TimeExpert: An Expert-Guided Video LLM for Video Temporal Grounding

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: Extensive experiments demonstrate that TimeExpert consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance on various VTG tasks such as Dense Video Captioning, Moment Retrieval, and Video Highlight Detection.

evidence.quote: More recently, Video Large Language Models (Video- LLMs) [5, 27, 29, 46, 55] have made remarkable advancements in coarse-grained video content understanding (e.g., VideoQA [11, 27]), yet they struggle to extend such capabilities to tasks requiring fine-grained temporal localization (e.g., VTG [13, 64]), due to the lack of dedicated mechanisms for explicitly modeling temporal boundaries.

evidence.quote: Compared to generalist Video-LLMs, VTG-specific models that encode temporal tokens [15, 20, 45] or are trained on temporally-annotated instruction-tuning datasets [19, 40, 49] demonstrate marginal improvements, as they blend temporal information with text tokens without explicitly modeling timestamps and saliency scores, despite videos inherently possessing structured information beyond textual descriptions [16].
